question: M, N, O, P, Y and Z live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6. Only two people live between N and P. Only two people live between Z and O. No one lives above Z. P lives below O but above Y. How many people lives below M?
solution:
Given: Six people M, N, O, P, Y, and Z live on six different floors (numbered 1 to 6 from bottom to top).

Let's deduce the floor arrangement based on the given clues:

1) "No one lives above Z."

This means Z lives on the topmost floor (Floor 6).
